His much-anticipated film 'Seyon' is currently in progress and is set for a release next year, with plans for family-oriented screenings afterward.

title: Daler Mehndi row ends? Minister Subodh Uniyal apologises over phone

Singer Mika Singh's team expressed appreciation for the minister's gesture and emphasized the importance of respecting artists. After the apology, both brothers plan to visit Uttarakhand for a performance invitation from Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami.

title: Javed Akhtar defends Rashmika amid criticism over her Hindi accent: 'This is not acceptable'
